title: The Past Tense — Strong Verbs
subtitle: Riden → rood, singen → sang — ablaut survives.
objectives: Master The Past Tense — Strong Verbs.
Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Riden becomes rood (singular) or riden (plural). Singen becomes sang or sungen. The old ablaut patterns survive from Old English but simplified. Seven classes reduced to irregular verbs. You learn them one by one.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you understand The Past Tense — Strong Verbs.
